Gibraltar vs Sao Tome e Principe Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

The friendly between Gibraltar and Sao Tome e Principe is scheduled for 23 September 2026 at 16:00 UTC at Europa Point Stadium in Gibraltar. The match falls outside any official tournament or league competition and serves as a preparatory fixture for both sides.

Gibraltar, who compete in UEFA Nations League D, will use the game to assess squad depth and tactical options ahead of their next competitive window. Sao Tome e Principe, currently involved in Africa Cup of Nations qualification, will look to fine-tune their preparations. No points, qualification implications, or league-table positions are at stake.
